newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Matahari Tasikmalaya shop damaged on riot.
newsitem.headline: Matahari Tasikmalaya shop damaged on riot.

text.p: One of Indonesia's largest retailers PT Matahari Putra Prima said on Friday its only outlet in the western Javanese town of Tasikmalaya was damaged by rioters on Thursday.

"Yes, our outlet in Tasikmalaya has been damaged by the mob. But I can't give you more details at this time as the phone lines to the outlet are still not working properly," public relations officer Sasa Rinasanti told Reuters.

Officials and residents in Tasikmalaya, 200 km southeast of Jakarta, said a rampaging mob set fire to a number of commercial buildings including the Matahari outlet and churches on Thursday after police had allegedly beaten three religious teachers.

Matahari said in August it was forced to lower its 1996 net profit forecast to 46 billion rupiah from the previous 50 billion rupiah in the wake of a sales drop after July 27 riots in Jakarta, the worst to hit the capital in more than 20 years.
Rinasanti declined to elaborate on the extend of the damage, saying the company had sent a team to investigate.
She said the Tasikmalaya outlet has a 2,000 sq metre floor space, less than the company's average outlet size of 4,000 sq metres.
Rinasanti said Matahari has around 80 outlets, 20 of them are located in West Java, 16 in Jakarta and the rest scattered through the country's various provinces.
Tasikmalaya was quiet but tense on Friday, with at least two people reported dead.
